findings.title: BOSSAI: Inside the AI attack mesh that targeted Taiwan’s emergency services
findings.summary_md: Acronis Threat Research Unit disclosed that a single operator in Hualien City, Taiwan, ran a mesh of 12 AI agents called BOSSAI that targeted hundreds of organizations across 11 countries. Confirmed breaches included a Taipei fire-department patient-care platform exposing medical records dating to 2018 (ECG readings, ambulance video, patient vital signs) without authentication, plus case records pulled from Taipei's 119 emergency-dispatch API across seven districts. The operator was attributed with high confidence through OPSEC failures including a home IP shared with a Korean skincare storefront and a GitHub account tied to a gas store in Hualien County.

findings.title: One Hacker Used 12 AI Agents to Target Taiwan's Emergency Services
findings.summary_md: eSecurityPlanet summarized the Acronis TRU BOSSAI investigation, reporting that a single operator used 12 AI agents to target hundreds of organizations across 11 countries and exposed Taiwan emergency records. The accessible medical records dated to 2018 and included ECG readings, ambulance video footage, and patient vital signs, while agents also accessed a city's 119 emergency-dispatch system. The campaign also hit universities, financial firms, and government systems.
